description.zh-CN: 类 Claude / Codex 桌面端的对话工作台：流式输出、工具调用可展开查看，能查询与整理游戏库、刮削官网信息入库、执行命令（需确认）。基于 pi（pi-ai + pi-agent-core），支持 OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic 接口。
description.en-US: A Claude / Codex desktop style chat workspace: streaming replies, expandable tool calls, library search and editing, scraping game sites into the library, and confirmed shell commands. Built on pi (pi-ai + pi-agent-core); OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic endpoints.
